covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the U.S. market close on Wednesday, July 29, 2026, plus companies reporting before the U.S. market open on Thursday, July 30, 2026.

market_context_summary: The report was generated while the U.S. market was open on July 29, 2026. Macro context was unusually important: investors were waiting for the Fed decision, oil had jumped on renewed Middle East conflict, and AI-related stocks were under pressure ahead of Microsoft and Meta.

research_allocation_view.plain_statement: This is a research prioritization model, not financial advice.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Valero has the cleanest positive earnings setup in the window if high refining-margin expectations are confirmed rather than treated as fully priced.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus expects a large year-over-year EPS rebound, with estimates around $9.87 to $10.13 and revenue near $39.5 billion.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Higher refining margins, strong throughput, dividend/buyback confidence, and oil-linked sentiment could support an upward reaction.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A strong quarter may be discounted after a large 52-week run, and any crack-spread or renewable diesel softness could cap the move.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Implied one-day move cited near 4.3%; not enough evidence of extreme crowding.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent preview coverage points to strong expected EPS growth and improved Wall Street sentiment.

ranked_companies.pass_agreement: All three bearish, but reversal risk high
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The base case leans down because crypto revenue and expense pressure may outweigh stock/options and prediction-market growth.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus clusters around $0.43 EPS and $1.29 billion revenue, with attention on crypto revenue declines and operating expenses.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Strong equities/options activity, prediction-market traction, or reassuring product economics could trigger a relief rally.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Crypto revenue shortfall, expense growth, or weaker monetization of new products could pressure the stock.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: One preview cited an implied post-earnings move near 10.8%, indicating high event risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Some analysts raised targets ahead of the print, which partly offsets the bearish base case.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: EMCOR screens positively if backlog conversion and electrical/mechanical margin strength confirm that data-center demand remains durable.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS has reportedly moved up over the last 60 days, with revenue expected to rise about 10% year over year.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Raised estimates, record backlog, data-center demand, and margin resilience support upside.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: The stock may need a clean beat and raise after a strong infrastructure rerating.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options evidence was limited; positioning risk is mostly valuation and crowded infrastructure ownership.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Zacks-cited consensus EPS rose from $7.02 to $7.23 over 60 days.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: AI capex guide versus ad growth
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Meta's ad engine may be strong, but the stock reaction likely hinges on whether AI capex guidance looks more disciplined than feared.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Revenue consensus is near $60.2 billion with EPS near $7.2; investors are focused on the $125 billion to $145 billion capex range.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Strong ad revenue, stable daily active people, or no capex raise could drive a relief move.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A capex raise or weak commercialization detail could overwhelm headline ad strength.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Barron's cited an expected move around 4%; positioning appears sensitive to AI spending.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analysts remain broadly constructive, but capex scrutiny has increased after Alphabet.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Quanta has a favorable demand setup if backlog and margin commentary support the market's AI-grid infrastructure thesis.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus expects roughly $3.29 to $3.33 EPS and revenue around $8.6 billion.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Utility, power, renewables, and data-center demand could support a beat-and-raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: High valuation and labor/supply-chain execution risk could turn a good print into a sell-the-news event.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Specific options data was limited; the main positioning issue is crowded infrastructure optimism.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent previews emphasize double-digit growth and strong backlog expectations.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: North America comps and margin recovery
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: All three bearish, but only moderate conviction
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The setup leans down because the stock has rallied into a still-unproven comp and margin recovery.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is near $0.65 EPS and $9.11 billion to $9.12 billion revenue, with attention on comparable sales and coffee/tariff margin pressure.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Positive comparable-store sales, China improvement, or clearer turnaround cadence could trigger relief.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Revenue decline, margin pressure, or weak traffic could challenge the year-to-date rally.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options data was not strong enough to drive the call; stock momentum into the event raises reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Preview coverage expects only modest earnings growth despite turnaround optimism.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Trane's premium valuation and high booking expectations create downside risk if the commercial HVAC acceleration cools.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The market expects strong commercial HVAC and applied equipment demand after Q1 bookings strength.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Another booking beat, margin resilience, or raised guide could squeeze the bearish call.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Any backlog or margin normalization could disappoint after the stock's strong multi-month run.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Recent trading showed weakness versus peers and above-average volume, suggesting active pre-event repositioning.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q1 results raised guidance; the Q2 bar is therefore elevated.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Mastercard leans up if cross-border and switched-transaction trends confirm resilient global consumer spending.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus estimates cluster near $4.77 EPS and $9.06 billion revenue, while Digrin shows $4.91 and $9.3 billion.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Cross-border volume, switched transactions, and services growth could sustain premium valuation.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Any travel or consumer-spending softness could weigh because the multiple is already demanding.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No strong options signal was found; risk is more valuation and macro sensitivity.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Zacks preview points to beat potential but warns about elevated valuation.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Crocs has relief-upside potential if HEYDUDE weakness is no worse than guided and the core Crocs brand stays positive.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company Q2 guidance called for slight revenue decline, Crocs brand up 1% to 3%, HEYDUDE down 12% to 14%, and adjusted EPS of $4.15 to $4.35.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Guidance already embeds HEYDUDE weakness, so stabilization or EPS delivery could lift the stock.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A renewed HEYDUDE miss or weaker full-year tone would likely overwhelm core-brand resilience.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Limited options evidence; turnaround positioning creates two-way risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent preview coverage expects revenue near $1.2 billion and EPS around the low $4 range.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Altria leans slightly down because the stock is near highs while cigarette-volume and discount-mix questions remain unresolved.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is around $1.48 to $1.49 EPS and $5.35 billion revenue, with full-year EPS guidance previously reaffirmed.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Stable Marlboro share, oral nicotine traction, and reiterated guidance could create a defensive relief move.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Smokeable volume pressure, discount mix, or weak on! PLUS uptake could pressure the stock after its run.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No clear options signal; defensive yield positioning may dampen reaction.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Preview coverage expects modest growth and attention to the $5.56 to $5.72 FY26 EPS guide.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Microsoft has real downside capex risk, but the de-risked stock and Azure beat potential keep the consensus at Neutral / No Edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: FactSet estimates cited by MarketWatch show $87.6 billion revenue and $4.24 EPS, with Azure the main stock-moving metric.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Azure above the mid-30s growth bar, credible Copilot monetization, or restrained FY2027 capex could drive relief.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Capex, cloud margin pressure, or soft FY2027 guidance could outweigh headline EPS.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Barron's cited a 6.6% expected move and elevated short interest versus history.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Some analysts have trimmed targets on capex and Azure guidance concerns.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Bristol Myers is too balanced for a strong event call because growth-portfolio and pipeline positives compete with patent-cliff risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Analysts expect about $1.60 to $1.61 EPS and revenue near $11.9 billion.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Growth portfolio strength, mezigdomide progress, or reaffirmed guidance could reassure investors.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Eliquis/Opdivo/Revlimid erosion fears and patent-cliff commentary could dominate.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No decisive options signal found; event likely driven by guidance and product mix.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q1 beat and reaffirmed guidance support the base, but LOE risk limits conviction.

disclaimer_text: This is research, not financial advice. Earnings reactions are highly uncertain and can be driven by market positioning, guidance, macro conditions, and management commentary rather than reported results alone.
